findings.title: source_location values are section fragments, not valid file paths
findings.why_it_matters: All 114 source_location values are Chinese section names (e.g., '禁用词正则部分', '镜头类型部分') rather than valid file paths. The Step0 docs' traceability tables claim these map to files like 'rules/Seedance2/Seedance2-禁止清单.md', but the actual values cannot be used to locate source files. This breaks the stated requirement: '图谱查询溯源记录需附加在最终合规预审报告中' — the provenance record is unverifiable.
findings.suggested_fix: source_location should contain actual file paths (e.g., 'rules/Seedance2/Seedance2-禁止清单.md') not section names. The Step0溯源记录 tables in all 4 Step0-图谱查询.md files list correct-looking paths but the graph.json source_location values do not match. Need to re-index graph with correct source_location values, or the Step0 docs' traceability tables are producing false claims of traceability.
evidence: Node 'forbidden_regex' has source_location='禁用词正则部分' but the Step0溯源记录 table claims it maps to 'rules/Seedance2/Seedance2-禁止清单.md'
Node 'seedance2_unified_formula' has source_location='统一公式部分' but Step0 claims 'rules/Seedance2/'
All 114 nodes with source_location have section-fragment values, not paths
Checking paths via os.path.join(base, sl) for all 114 nodes yields 0 valid file paths

findings.title: graph.json has no edges — provenance/relationship data missing
findings.why_it_matters: The graph contains 344 nodes but 0 edges. The Step0 docs describe graph queries with an implicit semantic network (e.g., '查询禁用词正则表达式 → returns prohibition_regex node'). Without edges, the graphify MCP tool cannot traverse relationships or validate query paths. This may cause queries to fall back to full-text search rather than graph traversal, defeating the purpose of graph-based knowledge retrieval.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-index source documents with graphify's full extraction (including edge/relationship creation), or document that the graph is node-only and queries should use keyword/semantic search rather than graph traversal.
evidence: Total edges: 0 (confirmed via python3 json parsing)
All 344 nodes have no 'source_location' pointing to valid files
The Step0 files describe graph queries expecting a semantic network, but the graph lacks relational structure

findings.title: mcp_config.json uses absolute path to graphify Python env — not portable
findings.why_it_matters: The mcp_config.json contains an absolute path '/Users/godxu/.local/pipx/venvs/graphifyy/bin/python' which will break on any other machine or if the venv is relocated. The Step0 docs reference this config as '连接方式见 Step0-图谱查询.md', but the config itself is not validated or checked into the repo.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a relative path or environment variable substitution in mcp_config.json, or document that this file must be customized per deployment environment. Consider adding mcp_config.json to .gitignore and providing a mcp_config.json.example template.

findings.title: Step0-图谱查询.md files copy-paste identical MCP connection instructions without validation
findings.why_it_matters: All 4 Step0-图谱查询.md files (Phase0, Phase1, Phase1.5, Phase2a, Phase2b) have identical '0.1 连接 MCP Server' sections stating '连接方式见 Step0-图谱查询.md'. This circular reference chain means if the MCP connection method changes, all 5 files must be updated. Additionally, no file actually describes HOW to test the MCP connection — only that Claude Code '自动处理 stdio 通信'.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract MCP connection instructions into a single shared file (e.g., docs/mcp-connection.md) and have all Step0 files reference it. Add a connection validation step (e.g., 'run graphify query "test" to verify connection').
